title: 2027 Summer Internship Program
about: The Television Academy Foundation's 2027 summer internships place enrolled college students in television-industry roles from June 14 to August 6, 2027. Applicants submit a 350-word essay; some categories require video work samples.
requirements: Undergraduate and graduate students enrolled in accredited colleges and universities, as well as students graduating in spring 2027
A 350-word essay describing what innovation and leadership mean to the applicant
Video work samples for some categories (e.g. Production, Cinematography)
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for "2027 Summer Internship Program" at Television Academy Foundation, United States, deadline 13 Jan 2027. Photo: Statue of Liberty and Manhattan skyline, New York.
